title: Missing Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy response header
description: The response omits Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy. CORP is what stops another site from embedding this response in a no-cors context such as an image, script or iframe tag. Without it, embedding is governed by browser defaults and by whatever CORS the embedding request carries, which is fine for public assets and wrong for authenticated documents.
remediation: Send Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin on authenticated responses, and same-site where subdomains legitimately share an asset. Keep cross-origin only for resources that are public by design.
limitation: Header-name check on one response. It cannot distinguish a public CDN asset from an authenticated document, so a deliberate public resource is reported exactly like an unprotected one.
